digest.component_or_area: core command routing and argument parsing (src/rebar/_cli/)
propositions: Core ticket, store, read/write, config, import/export, maintenance, and gate commands currently parse argv imperatively; adding docs-only argparse definitions would duplicate grammars that RP-05 must eliminate.

Each migrated command must capture its current production-path behavior (positive, negative, boundary, surplus/missing argument, option-space/equal, global-output, and -- semantics) from existing tests and define it in a side-effect-free S2a-contract argparse factory.

Core command families have opposite unknown-token semantics: some parse via parse_known_args (skip unknown tokens) while the positional-only leaf registry rejects stray option tokens with exit 2; each migrated factory must preserve its family's pre-migration semantics.

Runtime handlers must be switched to parse via per-command factories wired onto core Routes in _registry.py, with the router-level global flag extraction (--output, --quiet, --allow-secret-pattern) running before per-command factories see argv.

Parser construction must not import domain executors or optional dependencies; only the selected parser factory and handler are resolved during execution, verified by construction-exclusion probes and dispatch-isolation assertions.

Metrics commands are excluded (already migrated in S2c); all other 49 core commands must carry parser_factory references with no parallel imperative grammar, and each family must remain revertable as one self-contained unit (parser factory + Route wiring + handler switch).
